name: my-private-blog
//trustedDependencies: Empty on purpose: all dependency lifecycle scripts are blocked (the binaries the toolchain needs arrive as platform packages, not scripts). See methodology.md → Supply-chain: install policy.
//: A PRIVATE (capability-URL) blog: BLOG_PRIVATE=1 in .env inverts the engine's discovery surface, posts carry unguessable --<token> slugs (bun run new-post), and audit-private.ts proves the inversion on every build. See engine methodology.md → Private blogs. The deploy script deliberately has NO publish-notify/websub steps — announcing posts is the opposite of this blog's job.

scripts.dev:edge: bun run build && bun engine/generate/upload-audio-r2.ts --local && wrangler dev --port 3000
scripts.build: bun engine/generate/audit-license.ts && bun engine/generate/post-meta.ts && bun engine/generate/post-versions.ts && bun engine/generate/build-html.ts ./index.html ./posts/*.html && bun engine/generate/copy-static.ts && bun engine/generate/share-card.ts && bun engine/generate/strip-served-html.ts && bun engine/generate/figure-source-export.ts && bun engine/generate/markdown-export.ts && bun engine/generate/feeds.ts && bun engine/generate/site-discovery.ts && bun engine/generate/help-page.ts && bun engine/generate/licenses-page.ts && bun engine/generate/audit-posts.ts && bun engine/generate/audit-private.ts
scripts.deploy: bun engine/generate/audit-deps.ts && bun engine/generate/audit-licenses.ts && bun engine/generate/verify-narration.ts && bun run build && bun engine/generate/upload-audio-r2.ts --remote && wrangler deploy
